_comment: Known-answer vectors for Hearth Suite crypto review (P2-Q3, AC-SEC-12). See README.md in this directory for provenance.

ml_kem_768.note: Deterministic keygen from a fixed 64-byte seed and deterministic encapsulation from fixed 32-byte coins.

ml_dsa_65.note: Deterministic keygen from a fixed 32-byte seed; the verifying key is pinned by SHA-256.
